name: sticky
author: Tobotimus
kirin
description: Port of Tobo-Cogs' sticky. Sticks a message to the bottom of a channel by reposting it below new messages. Reads the stickies the original cog saved. Licensed GPL-3.0, like the original.
install_msg: Unload and uninstall Tobo-Cogs' sticky before loading this; every channel's sticky carries over.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no user data.
